summary: Finish browser send-grant evaluation after concurrent recovery discovery

replay.detail: Unknown attempts remain non-retryable; no automatic action replay is added.

schema.detail: No browser or server storage schema changes.

compatibility.detail: Chat and thread access publish after initialization when newer observations retain the same identity. A different identity triggers a fresh capabilities read and initialization rather than leaving the composer checking forever. Evaluation stops on abort or disposal.

recovery.detail: Recovery identity reads can advance the monotonic scope cache without starving send-grant evaluation. Loops advance only after newer different observations; no timer or fixed retry limit is introduced.
